name: Kairaku no Okite ~Aoi Taiken~
source:
An university student is hired by a wealth family(mother and two daughters) to tutor the younger daughter. Living at their house, he soon has relationships with the whole family, daughters' friend, and the two neighbors.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一名大學生受僱於富裕家庭，為家中的小女兒擔任家教。家裡住著母親和兩個女兒。住進她們家後，他很快便與全家人、女兒的朋友以及兩名鄰居發生了關係。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
